_about: The MODERN claim map (planning steps 182 and 186): which control a point of the view is on when the layer plays `--controls modern`, every 4th unit, at 16:9 and 4:3 at several ticks of a level's age with clear-portals hidden and shown, an early shot's state, the weightless level, the other two looks and three more window shapes. TWO ARRANGEMENTS of the walk arrows: the entries named `modern claim <state>` are the SPLIT one that ships (walk_left in the bottom-left corner, walk_right in the bottom-right one: the owner's decision of 2026-10-16), the entries named `modern claim arrows=grouped <state>` the GROUPED one (both at the bottom left: planning step 180's, kept as an alternative) with the values the golden held before, byte for byte. Every value is DERIVED from the independent model out/parity/program/CTL/CTL6b/work/model_claim_ctl6b.py (written from the design's section 1 and the owner's decision alone, no line of the module or the layer), never recorded from the binary alone; that model reproduces the 28 grouped values. It is never re-recorded to make a change pass: if the layout changes on purpose, the step says so and records why. Hashes are FNV-1a over one claim code per point; no pixel and no Asantee byte is here.
